biggest_catch: You can only open this at the Springfield location or through the Springfield invitation page — and you must hit 12 debit purchases plus a direct deposit or ACH transaction every month for four consecutive months.
catches: Account must be opened at the Springfield location or by invitation through the Springfield webpage, starting 03/16/2026.

For four consecutive months following account opening, meet the qualifications each Monthly Qualification Cycle: at least 12 debit-card purchases post and settle, at least one direct deposit or ACH transaction post and settle, and enrollment in eStatements.
ATM-processed transactions, transfers between accounts, non-retail payment transactions, and purchases made with debit cards not issued by Country Bank are excluded.
Primary tax owner must not have had a Country Bank consumer checking account in the prior 365 days; limited to one offer per person as identified by SSN.
$10 opening deposit; account must have a positive balance and remain open to receive the bonus.
The offer may be discontinued at any time; no fixed end date.
Bonus is tax-reportable; the customer is responsible for any taxes.
